The 2023 Annual Report is generated to familiarize the City and the community with all of the
important accomplishments of the Charitable Solicitations Commission throughout the 2023
calendar year.

The primary responsibility of the Commission is to ensure the compliance of charitable
organizations soliciting donations or funds from Beverly Hills residents. Compliance with
established permitting guidelines helps protect our community from fraudulent, fictitious, or
otherwise unscrupulous solicitations; it also serves to keep the community aware of the many
charitable events held in Beverly Hills. The Commission, in close cooperation with the Police
Department, regulates the issuance of solicitation permits, reviews financial statements provided
by charities, and maintains a dedicated website for the public to obtain information regarding
permitted solicitations.

During 2023, the Commission was successful in the following endeavors:

  1) The Commission issued 114 event permits and 40 monetary drive permits for events that
  concluded in 2023. Five permits were cancelled.

  2) The Commission reviewed 143 financial statements in 2023, and 8 financial statements
  are outstanding.

  3) The Commission worked closely with representatives of the Human Relations
  Commission to review and evaluate applications for the Community Assistance Grant
  Fund FY 24/25 to determine the allocation of funds based on service needs within the
  City. The two Commissions collaborated and successfully reviewed the proposals and
  financial information submitted by 31 organizations. As a result, a joint decision was
   made, and a recommendation was submitted to the City Council to approve 23 of the
  applications.

  4) The Commission has identified the “Top Ten” fundraising organizations and
  “Organizations with proceeds less than 50%.” The Commission believes that this
  information is valuable for community members to have available when they are solicited
  for charitable donations.

Detailed information collected throughout the year regarding permits, charitable organizations,
and financial data is presented on the following pages. The report summarizes all available
information as of June 19, 2024, regarding permitted and unpermitted charitable solicitations that
occurred during the 2023 calendar year.

Staff will follow up on pending financial statements and reports of unpermitted charitable
solicitations until all organizations comply with the City’s Charitable Solicitations Ordinance or
they are referred to Code Enforcement for appropriate action.
